mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1600, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to lowered borrowing costs.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 3.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.0% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, the combined signal of a strong labor market predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1.5% in a quarter, indicating robust supply-side activity, forecasts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when INDPRO increases > 1.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: Positive S&P 500 returns are expected over the next 5 trading days due to the consistent growth in real disposable income (RSAFS), fueling consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of all instances, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.5% in a quarter and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is below 250, the combined effect of monetary tightening with low inflation predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 45% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2% in two consecutive months, signaling a rapidly improving labor market, predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when UNRATE decreases > 0.2% over 2 months are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on interaction: The combined growth of GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) consistently forecasts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as both indicate robust demand-side activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of all instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
